scope: Execution refinement of existing 43 safety requirements / 175 variants; no compatibility waiver or implemented claim.

packets.title: Ownership review inputs and coverage ledger
packets.deliverable_and_exit_gate: Pin source/expanded AST and native-symbol inventories; seed stable review entries for every application/vendor file, ownership cycle, mutable definition, native boundary and indirect call. Reject omitted or stale entries.

packets.title: Review owner graphs and escaping aliases
packets.deliverable_and_exit_gate: Review every covered entry, caller/alias cycle and callback; record source-bound evidence, possible targets, release pairs, invalidation and error/signal paths. A recorded hazard needs a concrete finding and remediation packet. No automatic safe label.

packets.title: Compile-gated production allocation hooks
packets.deliverable_and_exit_gate: Add an off-by-default safety-injection Cargo feature. Begin at actual pager allocation before allocator/commit. Configure before application startup; fixed-size allocation-free hook hit evidence; deterministic site/ordinal; invalid plans fail closed. Prove normal executables ignore injection configuration and contain no hook entry points.

packets.title: I/O transaction callback and cleanup hooks
packets.deliverable_and_exit_gate: Expand the declared site inventory to file/pipe operations, before/after commits, filter replacement, native callbacks, helper handoff and cleanup. Use actual-error oracles, readiness barriers and conservation checks; retain primary errors and do not add handler allocations.

packets.title: Acceptance binding and coverage gates
packets.deliverable_and_exit_gate: Resolve all 175 exact named variants across required profiles into explicit rows; bind implemented row selections to exact source/hook/tests/results. Empty, unknown, duplicate, stale, unsupported and missing required rows cannot pass. M0 scaffolding is never full catalogue closure.

packets.title: Run fault profile and oracle controls
packets.deliverable_and_exit_gate: Exercise every declared reachable fault site and all required normal/native-instrumented/component profiles. Prove screen/mode/status/bell/effect/helper negative controls. Retain findings #9/#10 and unsupported boundary alternatives without suppressing application defects.

packets.title: Pin and build the glibc 2.41 environment
packets.deliverable_and_exit_gate: Resolve a Linux amd64 Debian trixie base to an immutable OCI digest; pin package versions/checksums and dated apt metadata. Match libc6/libc6-dev/headers/loader, native regex and terminfo. Record image/tool/header/library identities. Build without host include/library contamination.

packets.title: Reproduce baseline on actual glibc 2.41
packets.deliverable_and_exit_gate: Build and run inside the pinned rootfs; execute ABI probes, debug/release and reference 809 cases, helpers/integrations/real job control, clean install and source rebuild. Prove detector availability or retain blocked safety rows. Keep glibc 2.44 results separate.

packets.title: M0 closure and M1 handoff
packets.deliverable_and_exit_gate: Publish a source-bound closure report with every M0 obligation and remaining hazard disposition. Infrastructure may close with assigned legacy findings; unresolved ownership review, missing required hooks/controls or the declared reference environment cannot be called complete. No whole-core safety claim.

packets.title: M1 signal and blocked-I/O feasibility
packets.deliverable_and_exit_gate: Write ADR-SIGNAL-BACKEND and prototype blocked pipe reads/FIFO open, writer-connect-without-data, notification exhaustion and before-syscall cancellation with deterministic barriers. Prove resource lifetime and reference semantics before selecting the backend.

packets.title: M1 notification dispatch and lifecycle migration
packets.deliverable_and_exit_gate: Replace fabricated dispositions and handler-side pager work; main-loop dispatch, timer generations, notification accounting, inheritance and actual stop/child handoff. Execute every signal variant/profile and independent boundary review; later M2-M5 remain open.

m1_runtime_change_gate: C0-GATE plus C1-PROTO evidence; documentation and unreviewed inventories do not satisfy it.
